kg_pair_policy: R2_to_R3: HELPED if top10 hit appears or first-gold rank improves; HURT if top10 hit disappears or first-gold rank worsens; otherwise NEUTRAL

metric_policy.irrelevant_context_rate: non-gold hits divided by returned hits per query, then query averaged
metric_policy.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of first exact accepted evidence span
metric_policy.ndcg_at_10: binary relevance over exact accepted evidence spans, query averaged
metric_policy.not_applicable: version metrics omit queries without an expected version
metric_policy.recall_at_k: fraction of queries with at least one exact accepted indexed evidence span at k

nested_unit_policy: multiple gold spans are OR-equivalent within one query and are not independent samples
